tools.description: List the world's shamanic traditions covered in the library, grouped by region (Siberia, North America, Andes & Amazon, Mesoamerica, Asia & Oceania, Africa). Use this when someone asks which traditions or cultures the library documents.

tools.name: list_plants
tools.description: List the sacred plants documented in the library (name, latin name, tag, tradition, description). Use this when someone asks which plant medicines appear across the world's shamanic traditions.

tools.name: list_healers
tools.description: List the healers and elders documented in the library (historical elders and living practitioners), each with tradition, region and era. Use this when someone asks about notable shamans or healers.

tools.description: How the healing concierge works: the matching process, how healers are vetted, and the free 20-minute navigation call offer. Use this when someone wants to find a ceremony or healer in Ecuador and asks how to start.
